## Findings
- claim-1: In \(\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), Schur multiplication is truncated Littlewood–Richardson multiplication. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 263-269]
- claim-2: Put \(J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda\), \(L_\rho=\bar s_{(333,\rho)}\), and \(R_{\rho'}=\bar s_{(3+\rho'_1,3+\rho'_2,3+\rho'_3)}\). The following nine exact Pieri identities lie in \(A_+J\): \[ \begin{aligned} R_\varnothing-L_\varnothing&=0,\\ R_{1}+L_{1}&=h_1L_\varnothing,\\ R_{2}-L_{2}&=h_1R_1-h_2L_\varnothing,\\ R_{11}-L_{11}&=h_2L_\varnothing-h_1L_1,\\ R_{3}+L_{3}&=h_1R_2-h_2R_1+h_3L_\varnothing,\\ R_{21}+L_{21}&=h_1R_{11}+h_1L_2-h_3L_\varnothing,\\ R_{31}-L_{31} &=h_1R_3+h_1R_{11}-h_1R_{21}+h_1L_3+h_1L_{21} +h_1L_3-2h_3L_1,\\ R_{22}-L_{22} &=h_1R_{21}-h_1R_3-2h_1R_{11}+h_1R_{21} -h_1L_3-h_1L_{21}\\ &\quad-2h_1L_3-h_2L_2-h_2L_{11}+4h_3L_1,\\ R_{32}+L_{32} &=h_1R_{22}-h_3R_{11}+h_4R_1-h_1R_3+h_5L_\varnothing+h_1L_{31}. \end{aligned} \] Here repeated terms are intentional as written; every displayed Schur factor is in \(J\), and every \(h_t\) has \(1\le t\le5\).
- claim-3: No exact identity for the remaining boundary partition \(\rho=(3,3)\), \[ R_{33}-L_{33}=\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}, \] is supplied by the available material.
## Strategy
Use complete degreewise Pieri matrices for \(J\subset\Lambda/I_{5,5}\) in degrees \(9,\ldots,15\). For each \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), solve exactly
\[
c_\rho M_{9+|\rho|}
=\operatorname{coord}\!\left(R_{\rho'}-(-1)^{|\rho|}L_\rho\right).
\]
This would provide the required homogeneous \(h_t\bar s_\lambda\)-identities and quotient-coordinate transition blocks.

## Gaps
The supplied nine-identity table is invalid: its \((3,1),(2,2),(3,2)\) rows contain nonzero terms of incorrect degree. No exact witness is supplied for
\[
\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\in A_+J.
\]
No complete matrices or coefficient vectors \(c_\rho\) are available here. Therefore the requested transition
\[
\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,I_2,-I_2,I_2,-1,1)
\]
is not established by the present evidence.

## Next
Produce a corrected homogeneous ten-row Pieri certificate, including coefficientwise expansions, or task-owned matrix witnesses \(c_\rho\) for every \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), especially \((3,1),(2,2),(3,2),(3,3)\).
